title: Figure 61: half-symmetry UFO sphere mesh with 50 elements per wavelength, RCS model
description: ANSYS mesh plot captioned 'Mesh of 1/2 Symmetry UFO Sphere with 50 Elements per Wavelength,' labeled 'RCS of a Dielectric-coated Metallic Sphere for 300 MHZ UHF.' Finer hemispherical element mesh than Figure 60, dated Oct 27 2010. Refinement case for the BAASS radar cross-section simulation of a spherical UAP.
